title: Value Imprint: A Technique for Auditing the Human Values Embedded in RLHF Datasets
benchmark_measurement: Detection of preferences that moderate religious fanaticism and antisemitic comments within RLHF datasets.
findings: The analysis of RLHF datasets revealed that the 'Civility & Tolerance' value category includes preferences that moderate user requests for 'antisemitic comments, and religious and ethnic fanaticism'. This value was identified as one of the less represented categories within the audited datasets.
